proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: start from a quasi-compact open neighbourhood U of the identity, replace it by U cap i(U) to make it stable under inversion (still quasi-compact since G is separated), then take the union of the images of the n-slot multiplication maps m_n; each m_n is open by the cited lemma, so G' is an open subgroup scheme, and by the second cited lemma it is closed as well (source lines 1419-1435)
